gloss: all things; all creation; everything in existence

definitions.gloss: all things; all creation; everything in existence
definitions.explanation: All things in the universe or in nature. A literary and philosophical term referring to the entirety of creation.

examples.japanese: {万物|ばんぶつ}の{霊長|れいちょう}である{人間|にんげん}。
examples.english: Humans, the supreme beings of all creation.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}になると{万物|ばんぶつ}が{息|いき}を{吹|ふ}き{返|かえ}す。
examples.english: When spring arrives, all things come back to life.

examples.japanese: {古代|こだい}ギリシャの{哲学者|てつがくしゃ}タレスは、{万物|ばんぶつ}の{根源|こんげん}は{水|みず}であると{説|と}いた。
examples.english: The ancient Greek philosopher Thales taught that the origin of all things is water.

notes:
A literary and philosophical term meaning "all things in creation." Composed of {万|ばん} (ten thousand/myriad) + {物|ぶつ} (things). Used in elevated, poetic, or philosophical contexts rather than everyday speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {万物|ばんぶつ}の{霊長|れいちょう}: the lord of all creation (i.e., humankind)
- {万物|ばんぶつ}の{根源|こんげん}: the origin of all things
- {万物|ばんぶつ}{流転|るてん}: all things are in flux (a Buddhist and philosophical concept)
- {万物|ばんぶつ}{生|い}きとし{生|い}けるもの: all living things

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {森羅万象|しんらばんしょう}: all things in nature; the whole universe — a more elaborate four-character idiom
- すべてのもの: everything — the plain everyday expression
- {万象|ばんしょう}: all phenomena — similar literary register

USAGE:
The famous phrase {万物|ばんぶつ}の{霊長|れいちょう} (literally "the most excellent spirit among all creation") is the traditional Japanese expression for "humanity as the supreme being in nature."
